rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own basement structure (hardwood floor, drywall) and contents from a burst supply line within their home is direct property damage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Sam Patel (POL-1004) discovered extensive basement flooding upon returning from a work trip, caused by a burst supply line under an upstairs bathroom sink that ran for approximately two days. Damage includes approximately two inches of water throughout the basement, buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall (up to one foot), and ruined stored boxes. Estimated damage well exceeds $25,000 and requires prompt on-site assessment.

case_facts.description: basement flooded with approximately two inches of water across entire area
case_facts.damage_details: hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to one foot, stored boxes ruined
case_facts.discovery_context: policyholder returned from work trip to find flooding
case_facts.cause: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink; ran for approximately two days while policyholder was away
